verdict.rationale: Better Stack publishes its own per-endpoint Uptime API reference with copyable curl request examples, filter variants, and sample JSON responses, so a user can run the examples themselves. Nothing shows an interactive in-browser 'try it' console, and the OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every candidate path. Missing for 10: interactive in-page execution of API calls, a published OpenAPI spec to power interactive tooling, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples

citations.quote: Per-endpoint Uptime API reference ("List monitors") with copyable request examples per endpoint
Create monitor POST ... Update monitor PATCH ... Remove monitor DELETE
Simply include an `Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN` header in your requests.
